__documentation__: NOT RUNNABLE AS-IS. This file documents the input contract of the production
entrypoint: python3 paldo_production_entrypoint.py run --handoff FILE
It is the handoff that the external orchestrator (a Hermes cron agent) writes
after it has already performed every external operation: Apify discovery,
research, Writer, Reviewer, Gmail draft creation, and notification delivery.
The entrypoint itself makes no external calls. It validates this payload and
commits safe canonical references through
step22_integration.run_production_cycle().
Every value below is an obvious placeholder, and this file cannot be run: the
production path only accepts the canonical database, requires system_state=ACTIVE
and discovery_mode=LIVE, requires exactly two successful Apify actor runs (one
per lane), and requires a complete research packet per candidate.
Required top-level keys:
mode                   literal 'LIVE'
external_orchestrator  literal 'HERMES_CRON_AGENT'
run_id                 non-empty string; makes the cycle idempotent, a replay
of a finished run_id returns the stored summary
candidates             list, at most 50 items and at most 25 per lane
actor_runs             list of exactly 2 items, one PRIMARY and one SECONDARY,
each SUCCEEDED with remote_run_id and dataset_id,
actor_id equal to the configured apify_actor_id,
item_count 0..25, cost_usd 0..0.50
Candidate keys: lane, source_record_id, business_name, idempotency_key,
collected_at, research (object), decision_maker (object), messages (list).
A candidate is HELD, not failed, when research or messages are missing.
research keys required by the validator: business_identity, location, services,
official_website, booking_route, inquiry_channels, business_terminology,
operational_signals, observations, pain_hypotheses, sources, retrieved_at,
uncertainty, contradictions, proof_outcome_match, decision_maker_evidence,
evidence, gate_statuses.
sources items need a public html url plus retrieved_at;
evidence must be a non-empty list of signal records;
proof_outcome_match must hold 1 or 2 approved outcomes;
gate_statuses carries the four mandatory qualification gates.
decision_maker.route_type is one of OWNER_PROFESSIONAL_EMAIL, OWNER_LINKEDIN,
OWNER_PUBLIC_SOCIAL, MANAGER_PROFESSIONAL_EMAIL, GENERAL_BUSINESS_EMAIL, with
a public source_url and a verification_status; named routes additionally need
person_name and verified_role.
messages items (at most 3 per candidate) carry channel (EMAIL or LINKEDIN),
review_status 'PASS' from the Reviewer, a policy_context object, subject and
body for EMAIL, touch_number 1..3, gmail_reference for EMAIL, and
notification_reference. gmail_reference must show provider COMPOSIO, actions
CREATE_DRAFT and GET_DRAFT, a DRAFT label, sent false, and a content_hash that
matches sha256 of the rendered {to, from, subject, body} payload. Nothing here
is sent: EMAIL rows land in DRAFT_REVIEW_PENDING.
No credential material may appear anywhere in the payload: any key containing
token, api_key, authorization, or secret is rejected outright. Unknown
non-secret keys are ignored by the current validator.
This documentation key is for readers only and is not part of the contract.
